g.text: C1 edge X 188.60, band from X 184.00
Detail A: the 1450PF frame at the end wall, in section on the wall's straight part (|Y| under 107.90)
Detail A, the frame in section. Every figure is frame_seat.py's (constants, and
its own outer-face profile frame_half()) or its output frame_seat.out:
skirt: bottom 86.00 nominal, 84.38 to 87.62 on the legs (section (C)),
from the inner face X 183.34 out to the outer face, X 189.18 at the bottom,
189.48 at its widest (Z 94.76) and 189.29 at the gasket step (Z 100.22);
ring: underside 94.13 on the C6 pads, top 103.52, from the window X 174.83;
flange above the step: X 184.35; face plate C1 on the ring, top 106.52.
M21d (leg column to the skirt's inner face): 3.17 on the straight face drawn here,
2.48 nominal at the skirt's R 17.53 corner arc, where the leg's outer-back
corner sits (CASE-MARGINS.md, OPEN). M20: the skirt bottom sits 1.42 above
the end-wall rib tops 84.58; the same skirt bottom runs along the long walls,
where M10 and M14a measure the highest parts below it.
Not in this section: the frame's corner arcs, its insert bores and gasket, the
lid; the case's rim-zone face above the shoulder is drawn plumb (its draft
above the ledge is not in frame_seat.py).

Heights: boards E, E5, A and D from scene.py's render stack plus the 0.0 mm VHB 5952 lift (CASE-MARGINS.md C1 follow-on); board B, the pack top and the face from frame_seat.py, which CASE-MARGINS.md computes with.
Grey dotted and grey x: what panel1450.py still codes (face top 106.5, wall jacks at Z 59), superseded by C1, C6 and C2 until the CAD follows (S-27, ARCHITECTURE.md 7.1).

M1 is CASE-MARGINS.md's tightest chain: its heatsink height, the Xenarc depth and the spacers have no maker source, so it is OPEN (+3.62 at the worst). The bar at X 140 is the face top's range on the legs.

NOT SHOWN: board parts other than the CM5 heatsinks and fans, the backer ring C, the e-paper, the PA module under the plate, cables, the RF entry plates' outline, the connector plate, the QMX tray in the lid, fasteners, tolerance stacks;

the frame's corner arcs, insert bores and gasket (the frame is drawn in section on the end walls' straight part, detail A), and the case's rim-zone step above the shoulder in the main view (drawn in detail A).

Board E5's height is the render's (Z 6.0 before the lift); gen_pcb_e5.py's docstring says its face is at 7.4 mm: the controlling figure is the blind-mate gap window 12.4 to 14.4 (ARCHITECTURE.md 7.1).
